decisive_items: marked difference between direct and calculated LDL-C levels
response.rationale: High LDL-C levels and significant difference between direct and calculated LDL-C measurements support Familial Hypercholesterolemia over Statin-Induced Myopathy

rejected.why: Statin-Induced Myopathy is less likely due to lack of consistent evidence of myopathy and presence of other lipid metabolism issues
